data.body: **[P2] Preserve the root policy of visible replacement samplers.** For a visible provider whose sampler is no longer `DurableSampler`, this returns `null`; the later bridge guards then skip both carriers while `isSampled(null)` marks the synthetic execution ancestor sampled. A common `Sampler.parentBased(Sampler.alwaysOff())` consequently samples every durable span instead of applying its root DROP policy. Evaluate visible non-durable samplers once against `Context.root()` to derive the ancestor flags while still withholding the unconsumable carrier, and add a replacement-parent-based sampler regression test.
